title: Add ARM7TDMI disassembler, breakpoints, and CPU trace for GBA debugging
body:
## Sub-issue (#2207): ARM7TDMI Disassembler, Breakpoints, and CPU Trace (native-only)

- [x] Create `src/gba/debugging/` module excluded from WASM builds via `#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]`
- [x] ARM 32-bit disassembler (`disasm_arm`)
- [x] Thumb 16-bit disassembler (`disasm_thumb`)
- [x] Address breakpoint set (`Breakpoints`)
- [x] CPU trace ring buffer (`CpuTrace`/`TraceEntry`)
- [x] Debugger controller (`GbaDebuggerController`)
- [x] Address PR review feedback (ARM/Thumb shift `#0` special cases, doc clarifications)
- [x] 69 unit tests passing locally
- [x] CI hardened against transient apt DNS failures:
  - 3-attempt retry loop around the three `apt-get install libasound2-dev libudev-dev libdbus-1-dev` steps in `ci.yml` (rust-tests / rust-lint-pr / rust-lint-main jobs)
  - 3-attempt retry loop around `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` and `npx playwright install-deps chromium` (web-integration job — also runs apt internally)
- [x] Verified on b858201: `rust-tests`, `rust-lint-pr`, `wasm`, `changes` all green; only `web-integration` was cancelled at the un-retried Playwright apt step (now also retried)
- [x] `architecture.md` updated
